description: Branch R-SORT-3 Descriptor dispatch / Text levels: one element varied, the file version. The same 41-value corpus (supplementary-plane characters alone and beside letters, U+FFFD, U+FFFF, a lone surrogate pair of each kind, ligature and accent forms, Han and kana, 253-letter boundary values, controls, a Null) is written into T (K Text(255)) with the same locale in a file made with dbVersion 256 (ACCDB), with a non-unique index IX_K built after the rows; T0 is an unindexed copy. Reads GROUP BY K (first ID, count, last ID) in key order on T and on T0, ORDER BY K, ID on both, and the IX_K forward and backward walks. Asks whether the equality classes and the order (in particular supplementary-plane characters equal to the empty string, which was seen in dbVersion 128 and not in 256) follow the file version, the index, or neither.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
